requirements.contract: Organizer_Stage2_Technical_Specification_2.2/openapi/openapi.yaml schema CalendarEvent: id, organizationId, version, createdAt/updatedAt, projectId, title, description, eventDate, isAllDay, startAtUtc, endAtUtc, timeZone, status, userAttendees and contactAttendees; GET /api/v1/calendar-events/{id} maps to the read projection.
requirements.rules: CalendarEventQueryService mirrors the approved TaskQueryService pattern: it only loads through ICalendarEventStore.Get and projects into an immutable CalendarEventDetails record; it never mutates the aggregate and never applies lifecycle transitions; a missing event or an event of another organization returns null; timing fields are flattened to the OpenAPI shape; attendee collections are projected in stored order without copying cost changes.
